result.title: Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging
result.summary: We study how to learn an autoregressive next-token generator $f\colonΣ^\star\toΣ$ from a class $\mathcal{F}$, given chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations of length $T$ generated by $f$. We present a simple algorithm based on bagging, which outputs a majority vote of generators that are trained to be CoT-consistent on bootstrap samples of the training data. For binary token sets, it achieves the optimal sample complexity of $O((d_{\mathrm{VC}}+\log(1/δ))/ε)$, independent of the CoT length $T$, where $d_{\mathrm{VC}}$ is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{F}$. For finite token sets $Σ$, the VC dimension is replaced by a multiclass analogue, the Graph dimension $d_{\mathrm{G}}$, and the sample complexity is optimal up to a $\log|Σ|$ factor. The number of generators in the majority-vote ensemble is $O(\log(T/δ))$, and we show that the ensemble can be distilled into a single generator in $\mathcal{F}$ at the expense of $n\log(nT)$ unlabeled prompts.

AI.brief_summary: 从长度为 T 的 CoT 演示中学习自回归下一 token 生成器，提出基于 bagging 的多数投票算法：在自助采样上训练 CoT 一致的生成器并集成，证明二值 token 下样本复杂度为 O((d_VC+log(1/δ))/ε)、与 CoT 长度 T 无关，多类情形以 Graph 维替代并多出 log|Σ| 因子，且可将集成蒸馏回单个生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「样本复杂度与 CoT 长度无关」的结论可供核查 LVR 中长轨迹监督成本、贡献分配与长度泛化的理论预期，集成蒸馏也可视为一种监督信号压缩线索；但研究对象是纯文本 AR 生成，不涉及视觉证据筛选或推理期 latent 状态，迁移需较多核查。
